messages.author: c3afcb8e3d08e6f5
messages.subject: ggplot with rms package
parts:
Hello,

The newish rms package which is to replace Design says that it works
with ggplot2. However, I have not figured out a quick way to put in
the same sorts of plots with ggplot2.

plot(Predict(fit)) -> plots

ggplot(Predict(fit))
Error: No layers in plot

qplot(Predict(fit))
Error: attempt to apply non-function

ggplot(Predict(cumdsa400.lm), aes(cumdsa400, cumar400),
data=cumdsa400.lm) + geom_point()
Error in ggplot.data.frame(fortify(data), mapping, ...) :
Mapping should be created with aes or aes_string

Is it that it may work with ggplot, but you have to tell it the
parameters? That doesn't seem to be working either, i.e. telling it
what the x and y should be. I'm sure there is something obvious, but
it is confusing going back and forth between lattice and ggplot
graphics and I've been in lattice mostly of late.

Any suggestions are most appreciated.

Thanks, Aric
